Independently, re-parsing README.txt line by line reproduces the shipped original numbers 33/33, its line 32 ('ptci35 -> ptci21') resolving to ptci32 as the only unclaimed target and matching that line's own ordinal. Live item set from irw_table_sets() == shipped set, 33 items. NOT ESTABLISHED: the labels sort items into six classes only, so a permutation INSIDE a class -- above all among the 18 plain 'self' items -- would pass this test unchanged; no per-item statistic is published openly (the APA article is paywalled) to separate them. Hence PARTIAL, not VERIFIED. Corroborated off-source: a third-party 33-item PTCI handout (goodmedicine.org.uk) states its subscales in the SAME renumbered terms shipped here -- self 2,3,4,5,6,9,12,13,15,16,19,20,23,24,25,27,28,29,31,32,33 / world 7,8,10,11,17,22,26 / blame 1,14,18,21,30 -- a second, independent 33/33 class agreement, which still does not separate items within a class.

Route 3 (published subscale statistic) + route 6 (keying polarity), re-runnable as verify_qi_2025_dark_triad.R (VERDICT: PASS). Qi et al. 2025 report Cronbach's alpha for THIS sample as Machiavellianism .71, narcissism .75, psychopathy .64. Under the claimed mapping -- Mach = DT_1..DT_9, Narc = DT_10..DT_18, Psych = DT_19..DT_27, stored raw with the SD3's canonical reverse items at DT_11, DT_15, DT_17 (N2, N6, N8) and DT_20, DT_25 (P2, P7) -- the live data gives .712 / .748 / .637, i.e. deviations of +.002 / -.002 / -.003. Rival keyings miss badly: narcissism unreversed .135 vs .75; psychopathy unreversed .750, DT_25-only .771, DT_20-only .604, all against a published .64. Raw item-rest correlations corroborate the polarity per item: DT_11 -0.31, DT_15 -0.08, DT_17 -0.23 inside a narcissism block whose other six run +0.06..+0.32, and DT_25 -0.10 inside a psychopathy block whose other eight run +0.31..+0.62. (DT_20 reads +0.42 raw, yet reversing it is precisely what moves psychopathy alpha from .771 to the published .637, so it is the reverse item and merely a weak one here.) This does NOT distinguish the non-reversed items within a block from one another -- swapping the item_text of DT_2 and DT_3, or of DT_21 and DT_23, would leave every number above unchanged -- so it is PARTIAL, not VERIFIED.
